newsitem.title: USA: PHLX to list options on American Telecast, others.
newsitem.headline: PHLX to list options on American Telecast, others.

text.p: The Philadelphia Stock Exchange (PHLX) said Friday it would list options on shares of American Telecasting Inc and four other stocks on December 24.
The others include Ethan Allen Interiors Inc, Philip Environmental Inc, Provident Cos Inc and Public Storage Inc.

The American Telecasting and Ethan Allen options will have initial expirations in January, February, May and August. Philip Environmental options will have expirations in January, February, April and July.
Provident and Public Storage options will open with expirations in January, February, March and June.
Opening strike prices for American Telecast will be at 5, 7-1/2 and 10. For Ethan Allen, opening strikes will be at 30, 35 and 40.
Philip Environmental will open with strikes of 12-1/2, 15 and 17-1/2, Provident with strikes of 45, 50 and 55 and Public Storage with strikes of 22-1/2, 25 and 30.

Group One Ltd will be the specialist unit for American Telecasting and Ethan Allen options. G-Bar Ltd will be the specialist for Philip Environmental and Provident, and Gateway Partners will be the specialist for Public Storage options.
